points: 106-page report handed to the Federal Ministry of Justice and Consumer Protection on 8 October 2026
Agents should show past spending and let users set a monthly budget cap; background orders cancellable in one click
Cites forecasts that about one in seven online purchases could involve AI agents by 2030
take: The federal government's consumer advisory council wants agent providers to carry most liability for agent errors. Retailers and payment teams should expect budget caps, cancel buttons and disclosure duties.
title: SVRV: German consumer council sets 25 rules for AI shopping agents
